From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor registration and PO / VAT questions

Thanks Ben — I'm on it. Draft summary below that I'll put into the packet:

1) PO format and matching logic
- Redwood can accept a single invoice-level PO reference. Please ask Stellar to place the PO number in the invoice header as: "PO: 123456". If they are sending invoices via EDI/SFTP, the PO must also populate the metadata field "po_number" or "po_ref".
- If they provide multi-line POs, our matching tolerates line-level details but it's not required for payment release.

2) Remit / bank fields we need on every invoice
- Vendor legal name (as registered): Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Vendor address (one of the registered entity addresses)
- Invoice amount and currency (USD / EUR)
- Remit ID: formatted as "RID-<6 digits>" (we will supply their remit ID once vendor record is created)
- Bank details: Account name, IBAN (EU), SWIFT/BIC, bank name, beneficiary address

3) VAT handling (EU customers)
- Redwood can issue VAT invoices from our EU entity when applicable.
- For business customers electing reverse-charge, invoices must show the buyer VAT number and the phrase: "VAT reverse-charge — Article 194(1)" (or local equivalent).
- If Stellar needs us to issue VAT-inclusive invoices, we need their VAT registration and the billing country to determine tax treatment.

4) Required tax docs for vendor record
- W-9 (US entity) or W-8BEN-E (non-US) where applicable
- For EU entities: VAT registration certificate if we will issue VAT invoices

I will assemble these into RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf and include a plain CSV template (vendor_upload_template.csv) with headers: legal_name, tax_id, remit_id, bank_account, currency, primary_contact_email, invoicing_method (sftp/email/edi). Laura — can you confirm the CSV headers and whether we need an "entity_id" column for multi-entity customers?

Marissa
Head of Customer Success Operations
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor registration and PO / VAT questions

Looping in my vendor ingestion notes — attaching the CSV we use for portal uploads. A few specifics: 

- vendor_upload_template.csv columns (confirmed): legal_name, doing_business_as, tax_id, remit_id, remit_bank_name, remit_iban, remit_swift, currency, primary_contact_name, primary_contact_email, invoicing_method, default_payment_terms, entity_id
- entity_id is required when a customer has multiple billing entities (Stellar indicated they may bill from two EU subsidiaries). If they only have one billing entity, entity_id can be blank.
- For remit_id best practice: we ask customers to use a stable 6-digit code (RID-123456). This is the string we will surface in the invoice QR/Remit header for faster reconciliation.
- Sample PO image attached to show where the PO must appear on the invoice (top-right header) — PO-sample-RemitID.png

I attached vendor_upload_template.csv and the sample PO image. If legal needs to approve the VAT wording I'll ping them, but language above is standard.

Laura Bennett
Billing & Payments Lead
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Hi Elena — thanks for the request and for the form. We completed a short AP onboarding packet and included the CSV template to make bulk vendor creation straightforward. Attached: RI_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf and vendor_upload_template.csv.

Summary / next steps:
1) Complete the vendor_upload_template.csv with Stellar's vendor record data and return it to us (or push into your portal). Required fields are called out in the CSV header. If Stellar is bulk-uploading, include the optional entity_id for each billing entity.
2) Tax docs: if Redwood will be paid by a US entity please attach a completed W-9. For payments originating from EU entities, please include the VAT registration certificate for that billing entity.
3) PO expectations: Please put the PO number in the invoice header as exactly: "PO: ########" (we also accept the PO in an EDI/SFTP metadata field named "po_number"). If you have multi-line POs that's fine but not required.
4) Remit ID: Once Stellar creates the vendor record, please give us the remit_id you assigned (format RID-123456). We will echo that on every invoice to help reconciliations.
5) Sending invoices: We accept invoices via SFTP (credentials in packet), EDI, or email to ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com. When sending via SFTP/EDI, include invoice_number, po_number, remit_id in the payload.

If everything looks good I can loop in our finance team to provision early-pay options or alternate payment terms. For DocuSign enrollment (if Stellar requires signature for vendor terms) I have created a pre-filled envelope: https://docusign.example/envelope/AB12345

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you prefer to walk through the packet.

Best,
Ben Carter
